articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear celebrates scoring the winning goal for Middlesbrough against Lincoln.
images.alt: Middlesbrough's Will Lankshear celebrates scoring their side's second goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Riverside Stadium, Middlesbrough. Picture date: Saturday August 15, 2026.
images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.
images.alt: Middlesbrough's Will Lankshear (right) celebrates scoring their side's first goal of the game during the Sky Bet Championship match at the Riverside Stadium, Middlesbrough. Picture date: Saturday August 15, 2026.
images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP
articles.description: Australia international Nestory Irankunda will feature in the UEFA Champions League this season after joining Portuguese giants Sporting CP.

images.name: Nestory Irankunda [1296x729]
images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn
articles.description: Returning hero Raúl Jiménez rescued a point for Wolves at the death as they drew 2-2 with Blackburn in the Championship's curtain-raiser at Molineux.

images.name: Jimenez celeb [1296x729]

images.alt: Raul Jimenez of Wolverhampton Wanderers applauds fans after the Sky Bet Championship 2026/27 match between Wolverhampton Wanderers and Blackburn Rovers at Molineux on August 14, 2026 in Wolverhampton, England.

articles.headline: Dastan Satpayev signs Chelsea deal, joins Burnley on loan
articles.description: Chelsea's teenage forward Dastan Satpayev joined Burnley on a season-long loan on Friday after signing a six-year contract with the west London club.
